mapper.select: select c.certification_name, op.overall_ability overall_score, op.calculated_time from cm_user_goal g join cm_exam_certification c on c.id = g.certification_id left join cm_overall_profile op on op.user_id = g.user_id and op.goal_id = g.id where g.user_id = #{userId} and g.status in ('active', 'paused') order by case g.status when 'active' then 0 else 1 end, g.update_time desc, g.id desc limit 1
